metadata.title: MyInvestor runs its board, general meetings and shareholder register with Sttok
metadata.description: MyInvestor relies on Sttok for the digital management of its governing bodies, its shareholders and its corporate processes.
metadata.keywords: MyInvestor, Sttok, digital corporate governance, board of directors, shareholder register, Sttok customers

summary.title: MyInvestor digitises its corporate governance with Sttok

quote.text: Sttok has allowed us to digitise and automate all our corporate governance, from holding board meetings to keeping the shareholder register, ensuring maximum legal certainty in all our corporate processes.
quote.author: Legal Department

features.value: Board of directors, shareholder register, document management, general meetings

sections.title: About MyInvestor
texts: MyInvestor is a digital financial institution that operates as an agent of Andbank. It offers investment services, mortgages and current accounts.

sections.title: Why they chose Sttok
texts: 1. The need to digitise its corporate governance processes securely and efficiently.
2. The legal certainty the platform provides in document management and the traceability of corporate resolutions.
3. Efficiency in holding digital board meetings and managing online voting.
4. Automated generation of corporate documents and minutes.
5. The ability to manage the shareholder register and corporate documents digitally.
